title: The Half-Birthday of the Spring Tiger
skyStory: Last quarter moon in Gemini, exactly half lit, which is precisely right on the eve of the autumn equinox, when day and night split the hours like friends sharing a sandwich. The sun stands on the line. The twins hold a measuring tape. Saturn checks the math twice. Mars notes that a certain Tiger was born on the opposite equinox, and demands cake.

reading: You were born on the spring equinox, so tonight's autumn equinox is your cosmic opposite, your half-birthday in the sky's own calendar. Six months ago the light was growing. Now it starts to shrink, and the Fire Tiger learns the second half of the lesson: the hearth matters as much as the hunt.

Look back over the last six months and pick out one moment you are proud of. Say it out loud. Then pick one moment you struggled and forgive yourself for it, quickly, like brushing off a leaf. The [[Temperance]] angel is pouring water between two cups to show you balance is something you do, not something you have.
joel.mission: Celebrate your equinox half-birthday with one small treat for yourself, no justifying it, no sharing it unless you want to.
joel.omen: A clock showing two identical numbers, like 6:06. Your year is balanced right where it should be.

reading: Joel's equinox half-birthday is a little bit yours too. You carry his ruby, after all, and tonight the light tips from his season toward yours, toward the long nights and the solstice where you were born. The Mountain feels its season approaching like a train you can hear before you see.

Send him a half-birthday message, ideally a ridiculous one. Half a cake emoji. Half a song. A card that says happy six months closer to your next lap around the sun. The [[Six of Swords]] reminds you that your crossing gets easier when you take turns rowing, and today is his turn to receive.
nancy.mission: Send Joel an absurd half-birthday greeting, literally cut in half, half a drawing or half a sentence.
nancy.omen: The sun setting exactly at a road's end. The light is changing hands, and you are next.

together.text: Equinox eve. Spring Tiger meets winter Mountain at the halfway point of the year. Exchange one sentence each about what the other brought into your last six months. Equal light, equal words. The sun will wait on the line until you finish.

game.intro: Happy half-birthday, Spring Tiger. Six months to go, so today Saturn only wants to see things that are half done.
game.prompt: Something in your home that is exactly half full, half done or halfway finished.
